semantics: Walk state contains previousX and normalized phase. Advance consumes only absolute actual x displacement divided by scaled cycle distance; no velocity, elapsed time, team or speed multiplier.
Scale ratio is abs(actualScaleX)/referenceDisplayScale, since cycleDistancePixels already uses reference scale.
Explicit reset is required on spawn, pool reuse and teleport; ordinary movement in either direction is counted.
Zero displacement returns the same walk state, including a raised-foot frame; there is no implicit idle snap.
Attack selector returns null before0ms and from320ms, frames8..15 inside, and12 at160ms. It neither schedules nor applies damage.
integrationNotes: Current Battle.update calls updateRangedUnits then updateUnitPresentation. Formation limiting uses setPosition(limit, unit.y), while row alignment changes onlyy.
Local Phaser Systems.step: UPDATE -> scene.update -> POST_UPDATE. Arcade World.update is onUPDATE; World.postUpdate is onPOST_UPDATE and copies Body movement into Sprite coordinates.

For the phase shown in the same rendered frame, root should sample after Arcade World.postUpdate, with a listener registered after that physics handler. Sampling Sprite.x inside current Battle.update sees the pre-postUpdate coordinate.
Root still owns lifecycle reset hooks, attack/socket migration, phase storage, blocked formation stop/idle transition and live1x/4x/pause/teleport checks.
Schema checks and synthetic test metadata do not establish that all20 Blender gaits, measured foot contacts or wheel/track closures are approved.
